senses.gloss:
श्वि (connected with √ शू; sometimes written श्वा) cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xxiii, 41) श्व॑यति (pf. शिश्वाय, or शुशाव Gr.; aor. अ॑श्वत्, ŚBr., अश्वयीत्, HPariś.; Prec. शूयात् Gr.; fut. श्वयिता, श्वयिष्यति, ib.; inf. श्व॑यितुम्, Br.),
to swell, grow, increase, TS.; ŚBr. &c.:
Pass. शूयते (aor. अश्वायि) id., Car. :
Caus. श्वाययति (aor. अशिश्वयत् [Bhaṭṭ.] or अशूशवत्) id. Gr.:
Desid. of Caus. शिश्वाययिषति or शुशावयिषति, ib. :
Desid. शिश्वयिषति, ib. :
Intens. शेश्वीयते (Bhaṭṭ.), शोशूयते;
 शेश्वयीति, शेश्वेति, to swell much.
स्वी in comp. for 1. स्व.
स्वी , स्वी-करण &c. See p. 1219.col. 1.
श्वि॑क्न m. pl. N. of a people, ŚBr.

1. श्वित् cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. xviii, 2) श्वेतते (occurring only in pr. p. श्वेतमान, Mālatīm., and in aor. अश्वैत् or अश्वितत्, p. श्वितान॑ [q.v.] RV.; Gr. also pf. शिश्विते fut. श्वेतिता, श्वेतिष्यते, and aor. अश्वेतिष्ट),
to be bright or white :
Caus. (only aor. अशिश्वितत्; but cf. श्वेतय and श्वेतित) id., RV.
श्वित् [cf. Lith. szvailýti; Goth. hweits; Germ. weiss; Eng. white.]
2. श्वित् See उद-श्वि॑त् and सूर्य-श्वि॑त्.
श्वित mfn. white
श्वित n. whiteness, Sāy.
स्व्-इत॑ n. = सुवित, welfare, luck, VS.
श्वितान॑ mfn. being white, white-coloured, RV. vi, 6, 2.
श्विति (prob.) f. whiteness, a white colour, Sāy.
श्वितीचि॑, श्वि॑त्न and श्वित्न्य॑, mfn. whitish, RV.
श्वितीचि॑, श्वि॑त्न and श्वित्न्य॑, mfn. whitish, RV.
श्वितीचि॑, श्वि॑त्न and श्वित्न्य॑, mfn. whitish, RV.
श्वित्य mfn. white, white-coloured, MW.
श्वित्य m. (cf. श्वैत्य) N. of a man, MBh. vii, 2183 (Nīlak.)
श्वित्य॑ञ्च् mf(˚तीची॑)n. whitish, RV.
श्वित्र॑ mfn. whitish, white, AV.; TS.
having white leprosy, PañcavBr.
श्वित्र॑ m. a partic. wh˚ domestic animal or any wh˚ an˚, VS.
श्वित्र॑ m. n. morbid whiteness of the skin, white leprosy, vitiligo, Suśr.; BhP.
श्वित्र॑ m. = अन्तरिक्ष, Sāy. on RV. v, 19, 3
श्वित्रा (आ), f. N. of a woman, Sāy. on RV. i, 13, 14.
श्वित्र—घ्नी f. ‘removing white leprosy’, the plant Tragia Involucrata, L.
श्वित्र—हर mfn. removing or curing white leprosy, Suśr.
श्वित्रोपकाश mfn. looking whitish, ĀpŚr.
श्वित्रिन् mfn. affected with whiteness of the skin, leprous, a leper, Gaut.; Mn. &c.
श्वि॑त्र्य m. metron. fr. श्वित्र, RV. i, 33, 15 (Sāy.)

श्विन्द् (connected with √ श्वित्) cl. 1. A. (Dhātup. ii, 9) श्विन्दते (only pf. शिश्विन्दे), to be white, Hcar.;
to be cold, Dhātup.
श्विन्द् [cf. Lith. szvintù.]
स्विका . See स्वक, col. 1.
स्विका See under स्वक, p. 1278.
स्विन्. See शत-स्विन् and श्रोत्र-स्विन्.
स्वी—करण n. making one's own, appropriating, accepting, acquiring, Nir.; Yājñ.; Rājat.
taking to wife, marrying, Kālid. assenting, agreeing, promising, Sarvad.
स्वी—करण—कर्मन् mfn. whose function is to appropriate, Kull.
स्वी—करणीय mfn. to be appropriated or accepted or assumed or assented to or promised, W.
स्वी—कर्तव्य mfn. to be accepted, VarBṛS.
to be assented or agreed to, Sarvad.
स्वी—कर्तृ mfn. one who wishes to make one's own or win any one, Rājat.
स्वी—कार m. making one's own, appropriation, claiming, claim, BhP.; Siddh.
reception, Kathās.
assent, agreement, consent, promise, Sarvad.
स्वी—कार—ग्रह m. robbery, forcible seizure, Mcar.
स्वी—कार—पत्त्र n. a written document or will disposing of one's property, RTL. 531
स्वी—कार—रहित mfn. devoid of assent, not agreed to, W.
स्वी—का˚रान्त mfn. ended or concluded by assent, agreed to, ib.
स्वी—कार्य mfn. to be appropriated or taken possession of Rājat.
to be received, Kathās.
to be got in one's power or won over, ib.
to be agreed or assented to, Pat.
स्वी—कृत mfn. appropriated, accepted, admitted, claimed, agreed, assented to, promised, Kāv.; Pur. &c.
स्वी—कृति f. taking possession of, appropriation, HPariś.
स्वीय mf(आ)n. relating or belonging to one's self, own, proper, peculiar, characteristic, Kāv.; Pur. &c.
स्वीय m. (pl.) one's own people or kindred, ib.
स्वीया (आ), f. ‘one's own wife’, a wife solely attached to her husband, Sāh.
स्वीयाक्षर m. one's own handwriting or signature, autograph, L.
स्विद् [cf. Gk. ἱδρώς; Lat. sūdor, sūdare; Angl.Sax. swât; Eng. sweat; Germ. Schweiss, schwitzen.]
3. स्विद् (ifc.) sweating, perspiring, Śiś.
स्विदित mfn. sweated, melted, W.
sweating, perspiring, ib.
स्विन्न॑ mfn. sweating, perspiring, VS. &c. &c.
sweated, treated with sudorifics, Suśr.
seethed, boiled, Hariv.; MārkP.
स्विन्नाङ्गुलि mfn. having perspiring or moist fingers, Suśr.
स्व्-इध्म॑ mf(आ)n. consisting of good or dry wood, RV.
स्व्-इषु॑ mfn. having good or swift arrows, RV.
1. स्व्-इष्ट mfn. (√ 3. इष्) much desired or loved, R.
2. स्व्-इ᳙ष्ट mfn. (√ यज्) well or properly sacrificed, correctly offered, RV. &c. &c.
well worshipped or honoured, VS.; BhP.
स्व्-इ᳙ष्ट n. a right sacrifice, VS.; ŚBr.; MBh. &c.
स्व्-इष्ट—कृ॑त् mfn. offering a right sacrifice (esp. applied to Agni; superl. -तम), VS. &c. &c.
= -कृत, GṛŚrS.
स्व्-इष्ट—˚कृच्-चतुर्थ mf(आ)n. having Agni Sviṣṭa-kṛt as fourth, ĀpGṛ.
स्व्-इष्ट—˚कृद्-भाग m. the share of Agni Sv˚, AitBr.
स्व्-इष्ट—कृद्-भाजन॑ n. the substitute for Agni Sv˚.
स्व्-इष्ट—कृत mfn. belonging or offered to Agni Sv˚, Gṛhyās.
स्व्-इ᳙ष्टि f. a successful sacrifice, AV.; TS.; Kauś.
स्व्-इष्टि mfn. sacrificing well or with success, MBh.
